mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT case when T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS03} then T1.P_TRADE_ID ELSE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID END id, case when T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS03} then T1.P_TRADE_ID ELSE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID END text FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1
T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF01} AND T1.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID IS NULL
and (instr(TOTLE_TRADE_ID, #{search}) > 0)

choose.when:
SELECT TFP.FINPROD_ID totleTradeId, '' , T0.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T0.FINPROD_ID finprodId, T1.CONTRACT_NO contractNo, T1.CONTRACT_NAME contractName, FRI.BENCHMARK_ID targetId, T5.STRUCTURE_TYPE assetType11, T1.EXC_PS ps, TFP.TRADE_DATE cDate, TFP.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, T0.CCY ccy, T1.MDATE mDate, T1.PRIN amount, T5.EXE_PRICE exePrice, T5.KNOCK_PRICE knockPrice, T5.LOW_HIND_PRICE lowHindPrice, T5.LOW_EXERC_PRICE lowExercPrice, T5.HIGH_HIND_PRICE highHindPrice, T5.HIGH_EXERC_PRICE highExercPrice, T5.EXEC_BASE_DATE execBaseDate, FER.EXERCISE_TYPE exerciseType, T7.OPT_FEE_PAY_TYPE optFeePayType, T7.OPT_FEE_RATE optFeeRate, T7.OPT_FEE_AMT fpriceAmt, T1.COUNTER_ID counterId, null sffx, T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2 FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION T0 LEFT JOIN TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TFP ON TFP.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T0.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T1 ON T0.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T0.PORTFOLIO_ID left join FIN_EXERCISE_RULE FER on FER.FINPROD_ID = T0.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO FCI ON T0.FINPROD_ID = FCI.FINPROD_ID AND FCI.CASH_TYPE_1 ='02' LEFT JOIN FIN_RATE_INFO_STRUCTURE T5 ON FCI.CASH_ID = T5.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT_ADD T7 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T7.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON T0.FINPROD_ID = FPT.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_RATE_INFO FRI ON FCI.CASH_ID = FRI.CASH_ID WHERE T0.BRANCH ='0' and T0.HODING_TYPE = '03' AND FPT.TYPE_8 = 'F18' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD where TPD.FINPROD_ID = T0.FINPROD_ID AND TPD.ps IN ('T59','T60','T61') and TPD.Is_Cancel='N' and TPD.Trade_Status='01' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WTPD where WTPD.FINPROD_ID = T0.FINPROD_ID ) AND T0.CDATE = to_date(#{sysDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND T0.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
AND T0.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId}
choose.otherwise:
select WTFPDT.FINPROD_ID totleTradeId, WTFPDT.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, WTFPDT.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, WTFPDT.FINPROD_ID finprodId, FTR.CONTRACT_NO contractNo, FTR.CONTRACT_NAME contractName, FRI.BENCHMARK_ID targetId, T5.STRUCTURE_TYPE assetType11, FTR.EXC_PS ps, WTFPDT.TRADE_DATE xqDate, WTFPDT.TRADE_DATE fqxqDate, WTFPDT.PAY_DATE zfDate, TFPDT.TRADE_DATE cDate, WTFPDT.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, WTFPDT.ccy, FTR.MDATE mDate, FTR.PRIN amount, T5.EXE_PRICE exePrice, T5.KNOCK_PRICE knockPrice, T5.LOW_HIND_PRICE lowHindPrice, T5.LOW_EXERC_PRICE lowExercPrice, T5.HIGH_HIND_PRICE highHindPrice, T5.HIGH_EXERC_PRICE highExercPrice, T5.EXEC_BASE_DATE execBaseDate, FER.EXERCISE_TYPE exerciseType, T7.OPT_FEE_PAY_TYPE optFeePayType, T7.OPT_FEE_RATE optFeeRate, T7.OPT_FEE_AMT fpriceAmt, FTR.COUNTER_ID counterId, TPD.PS_PAYMENT sffx, FTR.FINPROD_TYPE2 finprodType2, WTFPDT.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL WTFPDT left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD ON WTFPDT.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TPD.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TFPDT ON WTFPDT.FINPROD_ID = TFPDT.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT FTR ON WTFPDT.FINPROD_ID = FTR.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT_ADD T7 ON WTFPDT.FINPROD_ID = T7.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE FPT ON WTFPDT.FINPROD_ID = FPT.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_EXERCISE_RULE FER on FER.FINPROD_ID = WTFPDT.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO FCI ON WTFPDT.FINPROD_ID = FCI.FINPROD_ID AND FCI.CASH_TYPE_1 ='02' LEFT JOIN FIN_RATE_INFO_STRUCTURE T5 ON FCI.CASH_ID = T5.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_RATE_INFO FRI ON FCI.CASH_ID = FRI.CASH_ID WHERE WTFPDT.PS IN ('T59','T60','T61') AND WTFPDT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F35' AND FPT.TYPE_8 = 'F18'
AND WTFPDT.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{busiCode}

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T WHERE T.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS03} and T.TRADE_ID = #{busiCode}

SELECT '${TRADE_FLOW_STATUS02}' statusValid, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, T5.FINPROD_ID, T5.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T5.FINPROD_ABBR, T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, T1.CHL_ID, T4.FINPROD_NAME, T1.PS, T3.REG_DATE, T2.TRADE_DATE, T2.SETTLE_DATE, T2.UNIT_CPRICE, T2.UNIT_INT, T6.TRADE_DATE redStockDate, sum(T3.REG_DATE_AMT) REG_DATE_AMT, sum(T2.FPRICE_AMT) FPRICE_AMT, sum(T2.SHARE_AMT) SHARE_AMT FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T2 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T2.TOTLE_TRADE_ID AND T2.PS = #{PS_T13} LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T3 ON T2.TRADE_ID = T3.TRADE_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = T3.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.CHL_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T4.IS_CHL = #{YES_OR_NO_Y} LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T5 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T6 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T6.TOTLE_TRADE_ID AND T6.PS = #{PS_T12} WHERE T1.P_TRADE_ID IS NULL AND T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{F10} and nvl(pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID,'null') = 'null'
AND T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{busiCode} GROUP BY T1.IS_CANCEL, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, T5.FINPROD_ID, T5.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T5.FINPROD_ABBR, T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, T1.CHL_ID, T4.FINPROD_NAME, T1.PS, T3.REG_DATE, T2.TRADE_DATE, T2.SETTLE_DATE, T2.UNIT_CPRICE, T2.UNIT_INT, T6.TRADE_DATE

SELECT '${TRADE_FLOW_STATUS01}' statusValid, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, T5.FINPROD_ID, T5.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T5.FINPROD_ABBR, T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, T1.CHL_ID, T4.FINPROD_NAME, T1.PS, T3.REG_DATE, T2.TRADE_DATE, T2.SETTLE_DATE, T2.UNIT_CPRICE, T2.UNIT_INT, T6.TRADE_DATE redStockDate, SUM(T3.REG_DATE_AMT) REG_DATE_AMT, SUM(T2.FPRICE_AMT) FPRICE_AMT, SUM(T2.SHARE_AMT) SHARE_AMT FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T2 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T2.TOTLE_TRADE_ID AND T2.PS = #{PS_T13,jdbcType=VARCHAR} LEFT JOIN WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T3 ON T2.TRADE_ID = T3.TRADE_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = T3.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.CHL_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T4.IS_CHL = #{YES_OR_NO_Y,jdbcType=VARCHAR} LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T5 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T6 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T6.TOTLE_TRADE_ID AND T6.PS = #{PS_T12} WHERE T1.P_TRADE_ID IS NULL and nvl(pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID,'null') = 'null' AND T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{F10}
AND T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{busiCode} GROUP BY T1.IS_CANCEL, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, T5.FINPROD_ID, T5.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T5.FINPROD_ABBR, T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, T1.CHL_ID, T4.FINPROD_NAME, T1.PS, T3.REG_DATE, T2.TRADE_DATE, T2.SETTLE_DATE, T2.UNIT_CPRICE, T2.UNIT_INT, T6.TRADE_DATE
SELECT * FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T where T.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{TOTLE_TRADE_ID}
SELECT * FROM PTL_TRADE T where T.BUSI_NO = #{tradeId}
SELECT * FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T where T.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}
SELECT * FROM STL_PAY_ORDERS T WHERE T.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

SELECT T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.SHARE_AMT, T1.FPRICE_AMT, T2.PORTFOLIO_ID, psp.sec_acct_id secAcctId,
T3.INVEST_YESORNO investYesorno,
T2.REG_DATE, T2.REG_DATE_AMT, T3.PORTFOLIO_NAME FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1, TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2, PTL_PORTFOLIO T3, ptl_sec_position psp WHERE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{TOTLE_TRADE_ID} AND T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID AND T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T3.PORTFOLIO_ID and psp.cdate = T2.reg_date and T1.finprod_id = psp.finprod_id and psp.amount = T2.REG_DATE_AMT and nvl(T3.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID,'null') = 'null' GROUP BY T1.FINPROD_ID,T1.SHARE_AMT, T1.FPRICE_AMT,T2.PORTFOLIO_ID, T2.REG_DATE, T2.REG_DATE_AMT,T3.PORTFOLIO_NAME,psp.sec_acct_id,T3.INVEST_YESORNO

SELECT T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.SHARE_AMT, T1.FPRICE_AMT, T2.PORTFOLIO_ID, psp.sec_acct_id secAcctId,
T3.INVEST_YESORNO investYesorno,
T2.REG_DATE, T2.REG_DATE_AMT, T3.PORTFOLIO_NAME FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1, WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD T2, PTL_PORTFOLIO T3, ptl_sec_position psp WHERE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{TOTLE_TRADE_ID} AND T1.TRADE_ID = T2.TRADE_ID AND T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T3.PORTFOLIO_ID and psp.cdate = T2.reg_date and T1.finprod_id = psp.finprod_id and psp.amount = T2.REG_DATE_AMT and nvl(T3.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID,'null') = 'null' GROUP BY T1.FINPROD_ID,T1.SHARE_AMT, T1.FPRICE_AMT,T2.PORTFOLIO_ID, T2.REG_DATE, T2.REG_DATE_AMT,T3.PORTFOLIO_NAME,psp.sec_acct_id,T3.INVEST_YESORNO
SELECT TRADE_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode} and PS = #{PST11}

select * from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL a inner join ptl_trade b on a.trade_id= b.BUSI_NO inner join ptl_portfolio c on b.PORTFOLIO_ID=c.PORTFOLIO_ID where( c.INVEST_YESORNO !='Y' or c.INVEST_YESORNO is null) and a.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId}

SELECT TARGET_ID id, TARGET_NAME text FROM OPT_TARGET_INFO
( TARGET_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR TARGET_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )
